'''Seeker of Dark Lung''' is a 5★ [[Great Sword]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A weapon equipped by Endfield operators to significantly boost their combat capabilities.|A standard greatsword developed by Hongshan Swordmancers. The weapon is furnished with a new specialized coating that offers excellent protection, even if the weapon were to be used in extreme and hostile environments.}}
